content.text: iVH does not view AI as a short-term technology trend.
**We have long researched AI as an integral element of system engineering,** designing optimal AI-based solutions tailored to the specific characteristics and constraints of each industry.
For iVH, **Physical AI Engineering** goes beyond algorithm implementation; it means **designing AI that operates safely and reliably within actual physical systems.**
iVH is not an AI company specialized in a single industry.
We possess **core Physical AI technologies that are commonly applicable across various sectors,**
and we expand them to fit each industrial environment.
Our key application areas include:

items: Factory Logistics and Integrated Control (AMR, Collaborative Robots, MES Integration)
NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) Interpretation and Quality Evaluation
Energy and Facility Operations and Optimal Control

content.text: While these may appear to be distinct industries,
they all involve problems where physical systems, sensors, control, and operational decision-making are integrated.
iVH addresses this structure from a common Engineering perspective.
iVH continuously **strives to combine Modelica-based Digital Twins with AI.**
This is a core strategy to overcome the limitations of data-driven AI.
Even in cases where field data is insufficient or experiments are limited due to risks, costs, or time constraints,
we can utilize Digital Twins to:

items: Perform AI training and verification in advance.

content.text: This **Sim-to-Real based Physical AI** approach enables iVH to design stable AI systems even in data-scarce environments.
iVH’s Physical AI Engineering is designed with industrial safety as its core premise.
We do not design structures where AI makes isolated decisions; instead, we engineer AI that includes control, verification, and monitoring at the system level.
Especially in environments such as:

items: Manufacturing sites where humans and robots coexist
Processes involving heavy loads or high-risk equipment

content.text: Physical AI must ensure **not only accuracy but also absolute reliability and safety.**

blocks.title: Understanding the Core of AI — and Evolving It

content.text: iVH is a company that understands the essence of AI.
**We design, verify, and operate AI within an engineering framework,** considering all of the following factors:

items: Optimal strategies when data is sufficient
Methods for combining physical models with data

content.text: Physical AI is not a finished technology,
but **an engineering capability that iVH continuously evolves.**

AI evolves,
and Physical AI must survive in the field.
iVH’s Physical AI Engineering does not stop at current products or industries.
Its scope of application continues to expand across Mobility, Smart Factory, Energy, and Safety-critical Systems,
while the technology is constantly verified and evolved through real-world fields.
This is why iVH defines Physical AI as its **Core Engineering Capability.**
